# std/shl

> << : shift left

truck [std](../std.md) · [source](../../../registry/std/shl.pkg) · translated by [bintables/shl](../bintables/shl.md)

```
print 1 << 10    // 1024
```

Infix, precedence 60, left-associative. Both operands must be `int`;
the result is `int`. Shift counts use the low 6 bits.
